method: Composite classification (not advice): equal-ish blend of valuation, growth, quality (ROE/FCF margin), leverage and 6-12m momentum. Letter grade + 0-100 score. Tilted to reward the 2026 rotation into cash-generative real-economy leaders (energy, power, industrials, defense, staples) and to penalize richly-valued momentum names showing distribution.
